mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND is_active = 1
SELECT * FROM pet WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1

SELECT p.* FROM pet p LEFT JOIN shared_access sa ON sa.pet_id = p.pet_id AND sa.member_id = #{memberId} AND sa.status = 'ACCEPTED' WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND (p.member_id = #{memberId} OR sa.access_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.created_at
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM shared_access WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet (member_id, name, species, breed, birth_date, gender, weight, neutered, medical_history, instagram_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{weight}, #{neutered}, #{medicalHistory}, #{instagramId})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET profile_img = #{profileImg}, character_img = #{characterImg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1

UPDATE pet SET name = #{name}, species = #{species}, breed = #{breed}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, weight = #{weight}, neutered = #{neutered}, medical_history = #{medicalHistory}, instagram_id = #{instagramId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId}
UPDATE pet SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
UPDATE pet SET reg_number = #{regNumber}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND is_active = 1
